summary: Expand Energy Corporation filed an 8-K reporting the completed acquisition of Twin Eagle Holdings N.A., LLC on September 16, 2026, marking the close of a previously announced transaction. Concurrently, the company disclosed that Dan Turco ceased serving as Executive Vice President Marketing and Commercial effective at closing, transitioning to Executive Vice President of Commercial Activities focusing on LNG and gas marketing integration. No purchase price, per-share terms, premium, advisor, or break fee were disclosed in the excerpt. Deal terms and financial impact remain unavailable, so the risk-arb angle centers on integration execution and any undisclosed consideration details.
